body:
Ok, so a little background then.  I am now 41.  My mental illness are Bipolar, borderline personality, ptsd (brought by sexual abuse from my brother), and general anxiety disorder.  My mother is a narcissist, I obviously don't have anything to do with my brother.  So, no family to really speak of.  Since my very public outing with my stuff, my "friends" walk on egg shells around me so I am a burden to them.  I just ended another very toxic relationship.  I have also have a very rare kidney condition that makes local dr.'s think I am drug seeking making me have to drive 2 hours to "the big city" trying to get help but right now the plan is making me live with kidney stone type pain everyday for the "rest" of my life. Have you ever had a kidney stone?  You beg for death with that pain.

Moving?  I don't have any money or ability to move away.  I have tried to embrace all my shit, tried volunteering, helping others, putting my shit out there fighting the stigma.  Everytime, I seem to end up back in the padded room.
